# Workout mapping corpus

`rotation.json` is the small independently specified projection and payload oracle.
The six named cases extend the extraction/decision corpus from `../../manifest.json`:
apply its `userDecisions`, then this fixture's `additionalDecisions`, and pass its
reserved `ids` to `mapReviewedWorkout`. `expected` contains the complete resolved
payload, ProgramDocument, cycle, provisional references and provenance target map.
Unknown schedules receive an explicit user choice; complex rules receive a written
scope choice in addition to the existing acknowledgement. No fixture changes the
source proposal. The tests separately check numeric values, preview, loss, bounds,
calendar semantics and blocking cases; snapshots are not regenerated by the tests.
